Definition: alive; also (as noun in plural) life
BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is the living, those who live, and Daniel uses it for the living God against the dead idols of Babylon. The secret is revealed to Daniel for the sake of the living, the living are to know that the Most High rules, Nebuchadnezzar blesses Him that lives for ever, and Darius cries to Daniel as the servant of the living God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the living God is the point of every one of these verses. The gods of Babylon cannot speak or save, but the living God reveals, rules, and delivers, and that is why Daniel's God is still the God I pray to.
RelatedPeople: Daniel; King Nebuchadnezzar; Darius the Mede
RelatedEvents: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling; Daniel in the Lions' Den
